title: Repository Guidelines
text: openlineage idiomatic R client OpenLineage framework, comparable Python client. Emit standards-compliant lineage events, using Python client behavioral reference without copying non-R APIs. Core concepts include RunEvent, RunState, Run, Job, Dataset, facets, configurable transports. Keep event models separate serialization, configuration, transport code.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: package version 0.1.0 targets OpenLineage schema 2.0.2. Implemented public pieces include validated S7 models run states, runs, jobs, datasets, run events, typed/common facets, generic facets, tags, deterministic JSON serialization, UUID event-time helpers, package constants, local transports, synchronous HTTP transport, R6 OpenLineageClient. client can emit injected transports, console output, -op mode, HTTP configured arguments OPENLINEAGE_* environment variables. default test suite offline covers models, validation, serialization, facets, lifecycle behavior, local transports, mocked HTTP transport behavior, client configuration, constants, run IDs, event times, checked-golden JSON fixtures. Generated documentation man/, _pkgdown.yml reference index, vignettes/openlineage-lifecycle.Rmd present. GitHub Actions currently includes R CMD check, pkgdown, coverage workflows.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: Put package code R/, following existing focused modules: R/models.R, R/ol-facets.R, R/serialization.R, R/transports.R, R/z-http-transport.R, R/client.R, R/validation.R, R/conditions.R, R/constants.R, R/run-id.R, R/event-time.R. Mirror tests tests/testthat/test-*.R; tests/testthat.R suite entry point. DESCRIPTION currently uses httr2 HTTP, jsonlite JSON, S7 models validation, R6 stateful client, cli user-facing conditions, uuid run IDs. Justify new dependency. NAMESPACE man/*.Rd generated roxygen2 comments must edited manually. Use vignettes/ workflows _pkgdown.yml documentation-site index.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: Rscript -e 'devtools::load_all()' loads package development. Rscript -e 'devtools::document()' regenerates documentation exports. Rscript -e 'devtools::test()' runs testthat tests. Rscript -e 'devtools::check()' performs full package check. Rscript -e 'pkgdown::check_pkgdown()' validates documentation site. R CMD build . creates source package archive.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: Use two-space indentation, <- assignment, snake_case names, base pipe (|>). Keep lines near 80 characters remove trailing whitespace. Document every exported function roxygen2 include executable examples practical. Run air format . Air available. Preserve OpenLineage wire-format field names serialization boundaries; keep R-facing names idiomatic.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: Use testthat edition 3; default suite must stay fully offline require OpenLineage server. Continue existing suite patterns: deterministic event helpers, checked-golden JSON fixtures, snapshot tests conditions, accumulating/-output fake transports. Use httr2::local_mocked_responses() assert request endpoints, headers, bodies, retries, failures. Compare parsed JSON unless formatting matters, table-test validation/configuration edges. disposable local stub-server tests must opt-. Run devtools::check() submission.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: Use concise, imperative subjects Add HTTP event transport. Keep unrelated changes separate. Pull requests explain motivation, public API protocol effects, link issues, report devtools::check() results. Call OpenLineage schema version used compatibility differences Python client. GitHub Actions R CMD check matrix must pass macOS, Windows, Linux; pkgdown coverage workflows also pass run.

title: Emit an OpenLineage Run Lifecycle
text: Package conditions stable classes can handled tryCatch(). HTTP 401 403 responses use openlineage_auth_error; HTTP failures use openlineage_http_error; delivery failures inherit openlineage_transport_error. Configuration errors use openlineage_config_error, invalid event, model, facet values use openlineage_validation_error. Conditions printed clients omit credentials.

title: Create and Emit OpenLineage Events
text: Use accumulating transport exercise complete lifecycle without server network connection: See vignette("openlineage-lifecycle") datasets, facets, configuration, authentication, failure handling.
code: library(openlineage)  transport <- AccumulatingTransport$new() client <- OpenLineageClient$new(transport = transport, disabled = FALSE)  run <- Run(new_run_id()) job <- Job("example", "daily-orders")  client$emit(RunEvent(run, job, event_type = "START")) client$emit(RunEvent(run, job, event_type = "RUNNING")) client$emit(RunEvent(run, job, event_type = "COMPLETE"))  length(transport$events) to_openlineage_json(transport$events[[3]], pretty = TRUE)

title: Synchronous HTTP transport — HttpTransport
text: Sends OpenLineage events JSON POST requests. base url relative endpoint joined one slash; URL already ends endpoint duplicated. Supply api_key Authorization: Bearer <key> authentication, place authentication headers headers. Supplying API key custom Authorization header error. custom headers redacted httr2 request printing. HTTP 429, 500, 502, 503, 504 responses low-level connection failures retried max_retries times. HTTP 401 403 responses never retried. Set verify_tls = FALSE controlled development environments; raises openlineage_insecure_tls_warning.
